## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused; callers and similar entry points have been checked.
- [ ] The v1 contract is preserved, or breaking changes have been discussed.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or their omission is explained.
- [ ] Verification covers the current changes; applicable checks have results and omissions are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal environment files, private planning notes or sensitive diagnostics are included.
